Definition: from G1427 and G5443; the commonwealth of Israel:--twelve tribes.
BiblicalUsage: The twelve tribes, the commonwealth of Israel, whose promise Paul says the twelve tribes earnestly serve God night and day hoping to attain.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the hope of the twelve tribes is my hope too: the promise God made to the fathers, kept for the children.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
